tests: [input.test] input tests Page.waitForFileChooser should be able to abort
reason: Waits for a file chooser with an AbortSignal, which rejects the wait with the signal's reason. Strider cancels a wait by interrupting it, which has no reason string (the same gap as FC-015 in page-filechooser)

tests: [input.test] input tests FileChooser.accept should fail when accepting file chooser twice
[input.test] input tests FileChooser.cancel should fail when canceling file chooser twice
reason: Checks Puppeteer's own bookkeeping for a file chooser that is accepted or canceled twice: its 'already handled' error message. Strider's handler returns one decision for each chooser, and no such error exists to check
